title: Nobody Talks In The QUIET Car 🚆
premise: On a sunny commuter train, anyone who says a word in the quiet car rides on out of sight until somebody answers them, and the shy narrator froze when his cousin Teddy said hey, so Teddy has been stuck aboard all year.
twist: The empty car is full of forty people who each said one word and never got an answer, all leaning in every morning hoping the quiet one will talk, so he says good morning to all of them at once and they all answer at once.
world: A bright silver and sea-green commuter train on an elevated line over pastel roofs: the quiet car is cream with ten rows of high-backed seat pairs, big windows and steel luggage racks, with a sunlit platform under a green canopy.
